senses.gloss: --survived the कुरुक्षेत्र war: grieved at कृष्ण's departure from हास्तिनपुर: received Vidura in joy. भा. I. १०. 9; १३. 3; X. ८०.[4].
--a son of Vasvananta, and father of सुभा- षण. भा. IX. १३. २५. [page३-034+ ३४]

--(see सात्यकि) the grandson of शिनि, and son of Satyaka, and father of Jaya.
1: भा. IX. २४. १४; Br. II. ७१. १०१; M. ४५. २३; वा. ९६. १००; Vi. IV. १४. 2.
Learnt the धनुर्वेद from Arjuna. Approved of द्रौपदी's suggestion to release अश्वत्थमन्: accompanied कृष्ण to हास्तिनपुर;
2: भा. I. 7. ५०; III. 1. ३१; X. ५८. 1; ६३. 3.
took active part in the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर: was sent to द्वारका for defence;
3: Ib. X. ७५. 6; ७६. 7[5].
went with the sacrificial horse of कृष्ण.
4: Ib. X. ८९. २२[2].
